extracted.name: Famous No Coffee Pumpkin Latte
extracted.description: This famous no-coffee pumpkin latte recipe makes a creamy, satisfying drink just like that popular coffee house serves, except without the caffeine.
instruction_lines: Combine milk, pumpkin, sugar, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a large saucepan over medium heat. Use a whisk to blend well. Heat to a simmer; do not boil.
